quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Pass only on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Slam on your brakes.
Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down to a stop.
Keep driving normally.
Turn on emergency flashers and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down to a stop.
questions.explanation: Do not brake hard. Grip the wheel tightly and keep your vehicle in your lane. Slow down gradually by releasing the gas. Once moving slowly, apply the brakes gently and pull to a safe area.

questions.question: After a school bus stops to let children off, what should you do?

options.text: Do not move until the children wave to you.
Watch for children walking on the side of the road.
Accelerate quickly.
Turn on your emergency flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking on the side of the road.
questions.explanation: After stopping for a school bus with its lights flashing, watch for children walking on the road. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ends ahead.
You must turn either right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road splits. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: If you are stranded in a snowstorm, what is the best thing to do?

options.text: Get out and walk for help.
Lie down in your car and sleep.
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in your car so rescuers can find you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car so rescuers can find you.
questions.explanation: Stay in your vehicle and wait for help. You are easier to find in your car. Walking in a snowstorm is dangerous.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at this speed.
The maximum speed is 55 mph under good conditions.
You cannot drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 55 mph under good conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed allowed. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: When stopping at an intersection with a stop line, where should you stop?

options.text: After the stop line.
At the stop line.
In the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: At the stop line.
questions.explanation: Stop lines are white lines at intersections. You must stop at the line when a pedestrian is present or when a sign or signal tells you to stop.

questions.question: What is the purpose of rumble strips?

options.text: To alert tired or distracted drivers that they are leaving the road.
To show that a stop is coming.
To help slow a vehicle with brake failure.

questions.correctAnswerText: To alert tired or distracted drivers that they are leaving the road.
questions.explanation: Rumble strips are ridges on the road shoulder. They create noise and vibration to alert drivers who are drifting out of their lane.

questions.question: If someone has drunk alcohol, what will help them feel better?

options.text: Tomato juice and lime
Hot coffee
Fresh air
Only time

questions.correctAnswerText: Only time
questions.explanation: Only time allows alcohol to leave a person's body. Nothing else speeds up this process.

questions.question: Are funeral procession escort vehicles classified as emergency vehicles?

options.text: Yes, they are classified as emergency vehicles.
No, they are not emergency vehicles.
Only when a police vehicle is escorting them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, they are classified as emergency vehicles.
questions.explanation: Funeral escort vehicles are emergency vehicles. Drivers must yield to them when they have proper lights or signals on.

questions.question: Children under age 18 must ride:

options.text: In the back seat.
In the front seat.
In a safety belt or child safety seat.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a safety belt or child safety seat.
questions.explanation: Children under 18 must be secured in a safety belt or child safety seat in a moving vehicle.

questions.question: After a train passes at a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Wait for the signal lights to stop flashing.
Look for a second train.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: After a train passes, watch for a second train on any track. Do not move forward until all gates are lifted and all warning lights stop flashing.

questions.question: To safely pass a bicycle, you should:

options.text: Honk to let them know you are passing.
Drive in the bicycle lane until you can pass.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Speed ahead and pull in front of them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: When passing a bicycle, slow down and give them plenty of space. Bicyclists have less protection than car drivers. Passing too quickly can cause them to lose control.

questions.question: Which of the following is not safe on the interstate?

options.text: Slower traffic stays to the right.
Change lanes without signaling.
Go to the next exit if you miss yours.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes without signaling.
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Keep to the right if you are slower than traffic. You cannot back up or make a U-turn on the interstate. Go to the next exit if you miss yours.

questions.question: Use high beam headlights when driving in fog.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: When following snow removal vehicles, stay back at least ____ feet.
questions.explanation: Stay at least 100 feet behind snow removal vehicles. These vehicles throw snow, sand, and ice that can damage your car or block your view.

questions.question: If your accelerator sticks while driving, you should:

options.text: Reach down and pull it up.
Shift to park.
Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal firmly.
Turn off the engine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal firmly.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, keep your eyes on the road. Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal steadily. When it is safe, pull to the side and turn off the engine.

questions.question: On a one-way street, you may turn left onto another one-way street only if:

options.text: You speed up before the turn.
Traffic flows to the right.
Traffic flows to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows to the left.
questions.explanation: You may turn left onto a one-way street only if traffic moves to the left, unless a sign says otherwise. You cannot turn left onto a street where traffic moves to the right.

questions.question: Your following distance behind a motorcycle should:

options.text: Be the same as for any other vehicle.
Decrease.
Increase.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase.
questions.explanation: Follow motorcycles at a greater distance than other vehicles. Motorcycles stop and turn faster than larger vehicles, so you need more time to react.

questions.question: "No zones" around trucks are areas where cars:

options.text: Blend into blind spots or are too close for the truck driver to stop and turn safely.
Have plenty of space behind the truck.
Are several car lengths away from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blend into blind spots or are too close for the truck driver to stop and turn safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are areas where cars disappear in a truck's blind spots. They can also be areas where cars are so close they prevent the truck driver from stopping or turning safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: A steady green light means you:

options.text: Must slow down and get ready to stop.
Must stop and look for traffic before going.
Can drive through if the path is clear.
Cannot turn right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive through if the path is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light lets you drive through the intersection if the path is clear. You can turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When turning, let other cars and walkers go first.

questions.question: You do not have to stop for a school bus with red flashing lights if it is on a private road.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You must stop for a school bus with red flashing lights and a stop arm out. This rule applies on both public and private roads.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right and then left.
The road curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells drivers about dangers ahead. It warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: If you are not in the correct lane to turn at an intersection, you should:

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make your turn.
Turn on your signal and turn from your current lane.
Go to the next intersection and turn there.
Safely change lanes and back up to the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go to the next intersection and turn there.
questions.explanation: Do not make last-minute turns. If you are not in the proper lane to turn, go to the next intersection and turn from the correct lane there.

questions.question: Drowsy drivers:

options.text: Should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
Can drive as badly as a drunk driver.
Can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.
Are usually only older drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive as badly as a drunk driver.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so poorly that they seem drunk. Opening a window, turning on the radio, or drinking coffee does not make a sleepy driver safe.
